sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Tunisia' ORDER BY name;
intent: List the names of all customers from Tunisia, ordered alphabetically by name.

sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Dune';
intent: What is the price of the product named 'Dune'?

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 0 ORDER BY name;
intent: List all product names that are currently out of stock, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;
intent: List the 5 most expensive products with their prices, from most to least expensive.

sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY order_id;
intent: List all order IDs with status 'cancelled', ordered by order ID.

sql: SELECT name FROM categories ORDER BY name;
intent: What are the names of all categories, in alphabetical order?

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY signup_date;
intent: List the names of customers who signed up in 2023, ordered by signup date.

sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31' ORDER BY order_date;
intent: List all order IDs placed in March 2024, ordered by order date.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE in_stock = 1;
intent: How many products are currently in stock?

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'London' ORDER BY name;
intent: List the names of customers based in London, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products;
intent: What is the average price of all products, rounded to 2 decimal places?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';
intent: How many orders have status 'pending'?

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 0 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;
intent: What is the name of the most expensive product that is currently out of stock?
watch_for: Only one row comes back even if several out-of-stock products tie on price.

sql: SELECT substr(signup_date, 1, 4) AS year, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
intent: How many customers signed up in each year? Show year and count, ordered by year.

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders;
intent: What percentage of orders have status 'completed'? Round to 1 decimal place.
watch_for: The denominator is ALL orders, not only non-cancelled ones.

sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' ORDER BY p.price DESC;
intent: List all product names in the 'Electronics' category, ordered by price descending.

sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name;
intent: How many products are there in each category? Show category name and count, ordered by category name.
watch_for: Categories with zero products do not appear (inner join).

sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
intent: What is the average price of products in each category? Show category name and average price rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by average price descending.

sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.name;
intent: List the names of customers who have never placed an order, ordered by name.
watch_for: The LEFT JOIN + IS NULL pattern means 'customers with no orders', not 'orders with a missing id'.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n_orders DESC, c.name;
intent: How many orders has each customer placed? Show customer name and order count, ordered by order count descending, then by name.
watch_for: Inner join: customers with zero orders are not listed. Grouping is by name, so two customers sharing a name would be merged.

sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books' AND p.price < 20 ORDER BY p.name;
intent: List the names of products in the 'Books' category that cost less than 20, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Yoga Mat';
intent: What is the total quantity of 'Yoga Mat' units sold across all orders?
watch_for: Counts units in every order regardless of status — cancelled orders are included.

sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;
intent: How many orders are there for each status? Show status and count, ordered by status name.

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) FROM order_items;
intent: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from all order items, rounded to 2 decimals?
watch_for: Includes cancelled and pending orders; uses the price at time of order, not the current product price.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'France' AND signup_date < '2023-06-01' ORDER BY name;
intent: List the names of customers from 'France' who signed up before 2023-06-01, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5;
intent: List the 5 products with the highest total quantity sold, showing product name and total quantity.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY c.name;
intent: List the distinct names of customers who placed at least one 'cancelled' order, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name;
intent: List the names of products that have never appeared in any order, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3;
intent: List the top 3 customers by number of orders placed, showing name and order count.
watch_for: Ties beyond the third place are cut arbitrarily.

sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
intent: How many orders were placed in each month of 2024? Show month as YYYY-MM and count, ordered by month.

sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY last_order DESC;
intent: List the names of customers and the date of their most recent order, for customers who have placed at least one order, ordered by most recent order date descending.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY n DESC;
intent: List the names of categories that have more than 5 products, with the product count, ordered by count descending.
watch_for: 'More than 5' — a category with exactly 5 products is excluded.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY name;
intent: List the names of products that cost more than the average product price, ordered by name.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price >= 0.9 * (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC;
intent: List the names of products priced within 10% of the most expensive product in the store, ordered by price descending.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'James Smith';
intent: How many distinct products has the customer 'James Smith' ordered?
watch_for: Counts different products, not units or order lines; includes cancelled orders.

sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
intent: List the top 5 customers by total revenue (quantity times unit price) from completed orders, showing name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Ergonomic Chair' ORDER BY c.name;
intent: List the distinct names of customers who have ordered the product 'Ergonomic Chair', ordered by name.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY n DESC, c.name;
intent: List the names of customers who have placed 5 or more orders, with their order count, ordered by order count descending then name.

sql: SELECT name FROM categories cat WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = cat.category_id AND p.price > 100) ORDER BY name;
intent: List the names of categories that have no products priced above 100, ordered by name.
watch_for: A category with no products at all also qualifies.

sql: SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product, p.price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.price = (SELECT MAX(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id) ORDER BY c.name;
intent: For each category, what is the name and price of its most expensive product? Show category name, product name, and price, ordered by category name.
watch_for: If two products tie for the top price in a category, both are returned.

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed';
intent: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from completed orders only, rounded to 2 decimals?

sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;
intent: Which 3 countries generated the most total revenue from completed orders? Show country and revenue rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by revenue descending.

sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN counts ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.n > (SELECT AVG(n) FROM counts) ORDER BY c.name;
intent: List the names of customers whose number of orders is above the average number of orders per customer, counting only customers with at least one order, ordered by name.
watch_for: The average is over customers who ordered at least once, not over all customers.

sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
intent: List the 5 products that generated the most total revenue (quantity times unit price), showing product name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.

sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name HAVING total_spent > 300 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
intent: Which customers have spent more than 300 in total on completed orders? Show name and total spent rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by total spent descending.

sql: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS n_customers FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY n_customers DESC, cat.name;
intent: For each category, how many distinct customers have bought at least one product from it? Show category name and customer count, ordered by customer count descending then category name.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS n_categories FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING n_categories >= 3 ORDER BY n_categories DESC, c.name;
intent: List the names of customers who have ordered products from at least 3 different categories, with the category count, ordered by category count descending then name.

sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY oi.quantity * oi.unit_price DESC LIMIT 1;
intent: What is the name of the product that generated the single highest revenue (quantity times unit price) from a single order item row?
watch_for: This is the biggest single order line, not the product with the most total revenue.

sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.name = 'Electronics') ORDER BY c.name;
intent: List the names of customers who have never ordered a product from the 'Electronics' category, ordered by name.
watch_for: Customers with no orders at all are included.

sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id);
intent: What is the average order value (sum of quantity times unit price per order), rounded to 2 decimals, considering only completed orders?
watch_for: Average of per-order totals, not the average order-line value.

sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;
intent: Count the customers in each country.
watch_for: No ORDER BY: row order is not guaranteed.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ORDER BY city;
intent: List every distinct city customers live in, alphabetically.

sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price < 10 ORDER BY price;
intent: Products cheaper than 10, cheapest first.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 20 AND 30;
intent: Products priced between 20 and 30 inclusive.
watch_for: BETWEEN includes both ends (20 and 30).

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Set%';
intent: Products whose name contains the word 'Set'.
watch_for: Matches 'Set' anywhere in the name, e.g. 'Knife Set', 'Building Blocks Set'.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'M%';
intent: Customers whose name starts with M.

sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1;
intent: The cheapest product.

sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 3;
intent: The 3 most recent orders.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled';
intent: Number of orders that are not cancelled.
watch_for: Counts both completed AND pending orders.

sql: SELECT name, country FROM customers WHERE country IN ('Egypt', 'Spain') ORDER BY country, name;
intent: Customers from Egypt or Spain.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country != 'Tunisia';
intent: Customers not from Tunisia.

sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS highest, MIN(price) AS lowest FROM products;
intent: Highest and lowest product prices.

sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items;
intent: Total number of units ever ordered.
watch_for: Units across all orders including cancelled ones.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM customers;
intent: Number of distinct countries customers come from.

sql: SELECT MIN(signup_date) FROM customers;
intent: The earliest signup date.

sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 5;
intent: Products ordered by price, positions 6 to 10.
watch_for: Skips the 5 most expensive and returns the next 5 (6th to 10th most expensive).

sql: SELECT name, CASE WHEN price > 50 THEN 'expensive' ELSE 'affordable' END AS price_band FROM products;
intent: Show each product with a label 'expensive' if price > 50, otherwise 'affordable'.
watch_for: A product priced exactly 50 is 'affordable'.

sql: SELECT name, ROUND(price * 0.8, 2) AS sale_price FROM products;
intent: Product prices with a 20% discount applied.

sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-07-01';
intent: Orders placed in the second half of 2024.

sql: SELECT name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE strftime('%m', signup_date) = '01';
intent: Customers who signed up in the month of January (any year).
watch_for: Any year, not only one specific January.

sql: SELECT order_item_id, order_id, product_id FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 3;
intent: Order line items with quantity 3.

sql: SELECT quantity, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM order_items GROUP BY quantity ORDER BY quantity;
intent: Number of order lines per quantity value.
watch_for: Counts order lines, not orders or units.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 1 AND price < 15 ORDER BY name;
intent: In-stock products under 15.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 0 OR price > 100;
intent: Products that are out of stock or cost more than 100.
watch_for: OR, not AND: either condition is enough.

sql: SELECT UPPER(name) FROM customers;
intent: Customer names in upper case.

sql: SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS len FROM products ORDER BY len DESC;
intent: Length of each product name, longest first.

sql: SELECT SUM(price) FROM products;
intent: Sum of all current product prices.
watch_for: Adds up the catalogue list prices, not sales revenue.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.unit_price <> (SELECT price FROM products p WHERE p.product_id = oi.product_id);
intent: Number of order lines whose unit price differs from the product's current price.

sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) / COUNT(*) FROM order_items;
intent: Integer average quantity per order line.
watch_for: Integer division in SQLite: the result is truncated to a whole number.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2022-%' ORDER BY signup_date DESC;
intent: Customers who signed up in 2022, most recent first.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY n_orders;
intent: Number of orders per customer, including customers with none.
watch_for: COUNT(o.order_id) gives 0 for customers without orders; COUNT(*) would give 1.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
intent: Customers with the number of their orders, but using COUNT(*) on a LEFT JOIN.
watch_for: COUNT(*) counts rows: a customer with no orders would show 1, not 0.

sql: SELECT c.name, o.order_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed';
intent: Customers joined with their completed orders only, keeping customers without any.
watch_for: The status filter is in the ON clause: every customer is kept, with NULL order_id if they have no completed order.

sql: SELECT c.name, o.order_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed';
intent: Customers joined with their orders, filtered to completed orders.
watch_for: The WHERE filter on the right table turns the LEFT JOIN into an inner join: customers with no completed order disappear.

sql: SELECT o.status, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status;
intent: Revenue per order status.

sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY n_lines DESC, order_id;
intent: Number of items (lines) in each order, biggest orders first.
watch_for: Counts distinct product lines per order, not units.

sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 5;
intent: Orders with more than 5 units in total.

sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
intent: Average quantity per order line for each product category.

sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING n >= 3 ORDER BY n DESC;
intent: Countries with at least 3 customers.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date > (SELECT MAX(signup_date) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Tunisia');
intent: Customers who signed up after the most recent signup from Tunisia.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items);
intent: Products never ordered, using NOT IN.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'pending');
intent: Customers who have at least one pending order, using EXISTS.

sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.status <> 'completed') = 0;
intent: Customers whose every order is completed (and who have at least one order).
watch_for: SUM of a boolean counts non-completed orders; requiring 0 means ALL their orders are completed.

sql: SELECT strftime('%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
intent: Order count per month name for 2024.

sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.country FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date;
intent: Orders with the customer's country.

sql: SELECT c.name, julianday(MIN(o.order_date)) - julianday(c.signup_date) AS days_to_first_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
intent: Days between signup and first order for each customer.
watch_for: Can be negative: orders in this data can predate the signup date.

sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.in_stock) AS in_stock_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
intent: Categories and their number of in-stock products.
watch_for: SUM(in_stock) counts in-stock products because in_stock is 0/1.

sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products), 1) AS pct FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
intent: Share of each category in the product catalogue, in percent.

sql: SELECT c.name, p.name, MAX(p.price) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name;
intent: Most expensive product in each category (SQLite bare-column trick).
watch_for: SQLite-specific: the bare p.name comes from the row holding the MAX. Ties return only one product.

sql: SELECT c.name, GROUP_CONCAT(o.order_id) AS order_ids FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
intent: Customers with a comma-separated list of their order ids.

sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
intent: Cities with more than one customer.

sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS times_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY times_ordered DESC;
intent: Products and how many times they were ordered, including never-ordered products.
watch_for: Counts order lines (how many orders included the product), not units.

sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC;
intent: Units sold per product, excluding cancelled orders.

sql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2024-01-%' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2024-12-%';
intent: Customers who ordered in both January and December 2024.

sql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';
intent: Customer ids who have placed orders but never had a cancelled order.
watch_for: Removes any customer who has even one cancelled order.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers UNION SELECT name FROM products;
intent: All customer and product names in one list.
watch_for: UNION removes duplicates (UNION ALL would keep them).

sql: SELECT city FROM customers UNION ALL SELECT country FROM customers;
intent: All customer cities and all country names, keeping duplicates.

sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY total DESC;
intent: Order totals for pending orders.

sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);
intent: Average number of lines per order.

sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT MAX(p.price) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books');
intent: Products more expensive than every product in the Books category.

sql: SELECT c.name, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY first_order;
intent: Customers' first order date.

sql: SELECT strftime('%w', order_date) AS weekday, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday;
intent: Number of orders per weekday (0 = Sunday).

sql: SELECT name, country, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.country = c1.country) AS same_country FROM customers c1;
intent: Customers and their country's customer count.
watch_for: Correlated subquery: the count includes the customer themselves.

sql: SELECT customer_id, AVG(status = 'cancelled') AS cancel_rate FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY cancel_rate DESC;
intent: Cancelled-order ratio per customer.
watch_for: AVG of a 0/1 condition is the fraction of that customer's orders that are cancelled.

sql: SELECT p.name, p.price FROM products p WHERE p.price > (SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id);
intent: Products whose price is above their category average.
watch_for: Compared with the average of their OWN category, not the store-wide average.

sql: SELECT COALESCE(country, 'n/a') AS country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1;
intent: Customer count per country, with unknown country shown as 'n/a'.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
intent: The second most expensive distinct price.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT o1.order_id, o1.order_date FROM orders o1 JOIN orders o2 ON o1.order_date = o2.order_date AND o1.order_id <> o2.order_id ORDER BY o1.order_date;
intent: Orders placed on the same day as another order.

sql: SELECT c.name FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING MIN(p.in_stock) = 1;
intent: Categories with no product currently out of stock.
watch_for: MIN(in_stock)=1 means every product in the category is in stock.

sql: SELECT c.name, p.name, COUNT(*) AS times FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, p.product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
intent: Customers who ordered the same product more than once (across orders).

sql: SELECT c.name AS category, p.name, p.price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_id ORDER BY p.price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id;
intent: Rank products by price within their category.
watch_for: RANK gives ties the same rank and skips the next number.

sql: SELECT category, name, price FROM (SELECT c.name AS category, p.name, p.price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_id ORDER BY p.price DESC) AS rn FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id) WHERE rn <= 2;
intent: Top 2 most expensive products per category.
watch_for: ROW_NUMBER breaks ties arbitrarily: exactly 2 per category (or fewer).

sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT o.order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_date) SELECT order_date, rev, SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY order_date) AS running_total FROM daily;
intent: Running total of revenue by order date.

sql: SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS nth_order FROM orders;
intent: Each customer's orders numbered in date order.

sql: SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date, julianday(order_date) - julianday(LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)) AS gap_days FROM orders;
intent: Days since each customer's previous order.
watch_for: The first order of each customer has a NULL gap.

sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(rev, 2), ROUND(rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS change FROM m;
intent: Monthly revenue and month-over-month change for completed orders.

sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id) SELECT name, ROUND(100.0 * rev / SUM(rev) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id), 1) AS pct_of_category FROM pr;
intent: Each product's share of its category's revenue.

sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.name, total FROM (SELECT customer_id, total, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS quartile FROM spend) s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE quartile = 1;
intent: Customers whose total spend is in the top 25%.
watch_for: Spend includes all statuses, including cancelled orders.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category_id = 1);
intent: Customers who never ordered a product from category 1 (Electronics).
watch_for: Includes customers who never placed any order.

sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.country) AS n_countries FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING n_countries >= 3 ORDER BY n_countries DESC;
intent: Products that have been bought by customers from at least 3 countries.

sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Beauty') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND oi.product_id = p.product_id));
intent: Customers who bought every product in the Beauty category.
watch_for: Double NOT EXISTS = relational division: 'there is no Beauty product this customer has NOT bought'.

sql: SELECT p1.name, p2.name, COUNT(*) AS together FROM order_items a JOIN order_items b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id JOIN products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id ORDER BY together DESC LIMIT 10;
intent: Pairs of products bought together in the same order, most frequent first.
watch_for: a.product_id < b.product_id counts each pair once and excludes pairing a product with itself.

sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM firsts f JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id AND o.order_date = f.first_date JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled';
intent: Customers whose first order was cancelled.
watch_for: If two orders fall on the first date, the customer qualifies if either is cancelled.

sql: SELECT c.country, cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS rev FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.country, cat.name HAVING rev > 200 ORDER BY rev DESC;
intent: Revenue by country and category, only combinations above 200.

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spent FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.name, ROUND(t.spent, 2) FROM t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE t.spent > (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM t) ORDER BY t.spent DESC;
intent: Customers who spent more in completed orders than the average customer.

sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 1) AS pct_cancelled FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY pct_cancelled DESC;
intent: Share of revenue lost to cancellations, per country.
watch_for: A share of order VALUE, not a share of the number of orders.

sql: SELECT n_orders, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) GROUP BY n_orders ORDER BY n_orders;
intent: Number of customers by number of orders placed (a histogram).

sql: WITH ot AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT c.name, ot.order_id, ot.total FROM ot JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ot.customer_id WHERE ot.total = (SELECT MAX(total) FROM ot ot2 WHERE ot2.customer_id = ot.customer_id);
intent: The largest order (by value) for each customer.

sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS h1, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS h2 FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING h2 > h1;
intent: Products whose sales in the second half of 2024 exceeded the first half.
watch_for: Compares units, not revenue.

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7)) AS active_months FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING active_months >= 6 ORDER BY active_months DESC;
intent: Customers with orders in at least 6 distinct months.

sql: SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY oi.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) = 1;
intent: Orders where every line is from the same category.
watch_for: Includes single-line orders, which trivially qualify.

sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(ot.total), 2) AS avg_order FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) ot ON ot.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING AVG(ot.total) > 100;
intent: Customers whose average order value is above 100, counting only completed orders.

sql: WITH cc AS (SELECT c.country, cat.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.country, cat.name) SELECT country, category, units FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY units DESC) AS r FROM cc) WHERE r = 1;
intent: The most popular category in each country by units sold.
watch_for: RANK = 1 can return several categories for a country if they tie.

sql: SELECT signup_date, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative FROM customers ORDER BY signup_date;
intent: Cumulative number of signups over time.

sql: WITH ot AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT customer_id, order_id, ROUND(AVG(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg FROM ot;
intent: Three-order moving average of order value for each customer.
watch_for: Window covers the current order and up to 2 before it, per customer.

sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND oi.unit_price > 100) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND oi.unit_price < 10);
intent: Customers who ordered a product priced above 100 and also one below 10.
watch_for: Uses the price paid (unit_price), not the current catalogue price. The two purchases may be in different orders.

sql: SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category_id = 1 THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) AS pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY o.customer_id;
intent: Percentage of each customer's orders that include an Electronics item.
watch_for: category_id 1 is Electronics; CASE without ELSE yields NULL, which COUNT ignores.

sql: SELECT p.name, p.price, MAX(oi.unit_price) AS max_paid FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING p.price > MAX(oi.unit_price);
intent: Products whose current price is higher than any price they were sold at.
watch_for: Never-ordered products are excluded by the inner join.

sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT m + 1 FROM months WHERE m < 12) SELECT m, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) = m) AS n_orders FROM months;
intent: Order count for each calendar month 1-12, including months without orders.
watch_for: Counts orders in that calendar month across all years, and shows 0 for empty months.

sql: WITH r AS (SELECT c.country, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT country, name, ROUND(rev, 2) FROM (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rev DESC) AS dr FROM r) WHERE dr = 1 ORDER BY rev DESC;
intent: Customers ranked by revenue within their country, top one per country.

sql: WITH ot AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT order_id, customer_id, total FROM ot WHERE total > 2 * (SELECT AVG(total) FROM ot x WHERE x.customer_id = ot.customer_id);
intent: Orders whose value is more than double the customer's average order value.

sql: SELECT cat.name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS q3, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS q4 FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY cat.name HAVING q4 < q3;
intent: Categories whose revenue from completed orders fell in Q4 compared with Q3 2024.

sql: SELECT name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date > date('2024-12-31', '-90 days'));
intent: Customers with no order in the last 90 days of 2024.
watch_for: Includes customers who never ordered at all.

sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM (SELECT price FROM products ORDER BY price LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) % 2 OFFSET ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) - 1) / 2);
intent: Median product price.
watch_for: Averages the middle one or two prices depending on whether the count is odd or even.

sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed') > 1 GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC;
intent: Number of repeat customers (more than one completed order) per country.
watch_for: Countries with zero repeat customers do not appear.

sql: WITH ot AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT customer_id, order_id, ROUND(total, 2), ROUND(100.0 * total / SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 1) AS pct_of_lifetime FROM ot ORDER BY customer_id, pct_of_lifetime DESC;
intent: Each order's value and its percentage of the customer's lifetime spend.
watch_for: Lifetime spend here includes cancelled and pending orders.

sql: SELECT p.name, MIN(c.country) AS only_country FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.country) = 1;
intent: Products that were only ever bought by customers from a single country.

sql: SELECT o.order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_date ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
intent: The day with the highest revenue and its revenue.
watch_for: All statuses count, including cancelled.

sql: WITH q AS (SELECT o.customer_id, (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS qtr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, qtr), d AS (SELECT customer_id, rev - LAG(rev) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY qtr) AS delta FROM q) SELECT customer_id FROM d GROUP BY customer_id HAVING MIN(COALESCE(delta, 0)) >= 0;
intent: Customers whose spend grew every quarter of 2024 (no quarter lower than the one before).
watch_for: Only quarters where the customer actually ordered are compared; a quarter with no orders is skipped, not treated as 0.

sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY units_per_order DESC;
intent: Average basket size (units per order) by country, completed orders only.
watch_for: 1.0 * forces decimal division; COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) avoids counting an order once per line.

sql: WITH u AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) SELECT p.name, u.units FROM u JOIN products p ON p.product_id = u.product_id WHERE u.units > (SELECT AVG(units) FROM u) ORDER BY u.units DESC;
intent: Products whose units sold are above the average units sold per product.
watch_for: Average over products that sold at least once.
